name: changedetection.io
short_description: Monitor any website for changes and get notified instantly via email or webhook.
description: changedetection.io watches web pages for any changes and notifies you the moment something updates. Track product prices, stock availability, news articles, government pages, job listings, or any content on the web. Supports CSS and XPath selectors to watch specific page sections, visual screenshot diffs, regex filters, and notification delivery via email, Slack, Discord, ntfy, Telegram, and 70+ other services through Apprise.
usecases: Monitor product pages for price drops or stock restocks.
Track government, news, or documentation pages for content updates.
Watch job boards or listing sites for new postings matching your criteria.
Alert your team via Slack or Discord when a monitored page changes.
notes: Supports 70+ notification services via Apprise (email, Slack, Discord, ntfy, Telegram, etc.).
Use CSS/XPath selectors to watch only a specific section of a page.
Enable the built-in browser (Playwright) for JavaScript-rendered pages.
